business_problem: Ladbrokes.live , a provider of streaming sports entertainment content operating in Belgium, was grappling with critical challenges that hindered their ability to attract and retain users. Partnering with AWS Partner Cloudar —also based in Belgium—the company transitioned to a cloud-native architecture powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
solution_summary: Ladbrokes.live , a provider of streaming sports entertainment content operating in Belgium, was grappling with critical challenges that hindered their ability to attract and retain users. Partnering with AWS Partner Cloudar —also based in Belgium—the company transitioned to a cloud-native architecture powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies. Crafting Scalable, AI-driven Sports Experiences with AWS Cloudar, a customer-obsessed technology consulting firm that specializes in AWS-powered solutions, partnered with Ladbrokes.live to address these challenges. Leveraging AWS, Cloudar and its implementation partner Keiro crafted a modern, cloud-native solution that took Ladbroke.live’s online capabilities to a new level. The new architecture was designed to handle the unpredictable and high-traffic demands of the sports entertainment industry, ensuring scalability and flexibility.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and generative AI application logic.

solution_components.name: Amazon Aurora
solution_components.role: Stores transactional data with higher throughput and availability.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores documents, media, telemetry, or training data durably at scale.

data_flow: Data is stored in Amazon Aurora, Amazon S3 and processed by Amazon Bedrock.
